:py:mod:`futuram.classes.parameters`
====================================

.. py:module:: futuram.classes.parameters

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   parameters.py

   This file contains the classes for parameters and scenarios.

   The Parameter class represents a parameter, which can be either internal or external.

   The Scenario class represents a scenario, which is a collection of parameters.

   The EXTERNAL_PARAMETERS list contains the default external parameters.




Module Contents
---------------

~~~~~~~

.. autoapisummary::

   futuram.classes.parameters.Parameter
   futuram.classes.parameters.Scenario

      The name of the parameter.

   .. attribute:: value

      :type: float

   .. attribute:: uncertainty

      The uncertainty of the parameter.

      :type: float

   .. attribute:: internal

      Whether the parameter is internal or external.

      :type: bool

.. py:class:: Scenario(name)


   A class to represent a scenario.

   .. attribute:: name

      The name of the scenario.

      :type: str

   .. attribute:: description

      The description of the scenario.

      :type: str

   .. attribute:: parameters

      The parameters of the scenario.

      :type: dict

   .. method:: set_parameter(parameter_name, value)

      Set the value of a parameter in the scenario.

   .. method:: set_description(description)

      Set the description of the scenario.

   .. method:: get_parameter(parameter_name)

      Get the value of a parameter in the scenario.

   .. method:: has_parameter(parameter_name)

      Check if a parameter exists in the scenario.

   .. method:: remove_parameter(parameter_name)

      Remove a parameter from the scenario.

   .. method:: get_all_parameters()

      Get all parameters in the scenario.

   .. method:: clear_parameters()

      Clear all parameters in the scenario.

   .. method:: to_dict()

      Convert the scenario to a dictionary.

   .. method:: to_series()

      Convert the scenario to a Pandas Series.


   .. py:method:: add_to_model(model)

      Set the value of a parameter in the scenario.

      :param parameter_name: The name of the parameter to set.
      :type parameter_name: str
      :param value: The value to set the parameter to.
      :type value: float


   .. py:method:: set_description(description)

      Set the description of the scenario.

      :param description: The description of the scenario.
      :type description: str


   .. py:method:: get_parameter(parameter_name)

      Get the value of a parameter in the scenario.

      :returns: Whether the parameter exists in the scenario.
      :rtype: bool


   .. py:method:: remove_parameter(parameter_name)

      Remove a parameter from the scenario.

      :param parameter_name: The name of the parameter to remove.
      :type parameter_name: str


   .. py:method:: get_all_parameters()

      Get all parameters in the scenario.

   .. py:method:: clear_parameters()
